scope: Versioned recorder repair and deterministic regression checks only; no selector performance trial, training, validation, test or deployment
hypothesis: A newer cached frame can have been generated inside R2 without ever being observed fresh by the sidecar. Monotonic cached metadata may be retained for diagnosis without becoming fresh range evidence.
changed_behavior: Validate cached_wait/stale snapshot provenance, flags, original time, sequence and bounded ray payload before accepting changed metadata.
Allow newer monotonic cached metadata and advance range high-water marks; keep all cached range features unknown and evidence_new.range=false.
Mark cached_metadata_advanced separately, never as a new independent fresh range frame.
preserved_behavior: Frozen v1 sources, protocols, tests, results and observer source remain untouched.
Reject same-sequence payload conflicts, future timestamps, sequence/time regression and cached-to-fresh relabeling.
Keep original times, bounded history/ledger/events, immutable returned copies, independent measured motion and exact ACK identity.
Keep recorder-only cancel/fault semantics, explicit fresh disarmed reset, manual/disarm precedence, 400ms command lifetime and zero generated/physical commands.
The wrapper passes the original caller request/null unchanged to the unchanged R2 plant; inertia/current/guards remain authoritative.

test_recipe.inherited_invariants: Run the existing 26 behavioral invariant cases against the NEW v2 implementation and wrapper, not against v1 again.
new_regressions: Replay only already-saved pre-fault packets into v2; no plant/policy rollout
First cached stream, multiple unseen cached advances and high-water marks
Rotated heading cache remains unknown, including ray projections
Conflicting/regressing/future metadata and false fresh flags remain rejected
Cached metadata with equal capture time cannot later be counted fresh
Small unchanged-R2 step then packet-loss integration reproduces the unseen-cache path
v2 schemas are explicit and all frozen v1 evidence hashes remain unchanged
test_recipe.unit_fixture_limit: The small parser-path integration fixture fixes random range dropout to zero solely to guarantee a newly generated internal range frame before explicit packet-loss injection; current remains0.08m/s and stress noise/gains otherwise remain. It is not a collection/collision benchmark or a difficulty change to any closed trial.

gate: All v2 deterministic checks pass, cached ray features always unknown, fresh count not inflated, old hashes unchanged, wrapped/original R2 snapshots equal in controlled tests; engineering review still required
